children: , the consumer-device and chipmaker, pitched its new Macs as a way for businesses to run AI models without paying for every cloud request. Shares were down about 0.7% at $337.22, compared with the previous close of $339.75.

The hardware is now on sale. Apple says its Mac Studio can hold up to 512GB of unified memory, giving large models room to run on the device. At a launch demonstration, four linked Mac Studios ran a trillion-parameter model from one wall outlet, according to Reuters. That is an eye-catching demonstration, though businesses will care more about the cost and effort of running their own workloads every day.

The picture puts a price on investors' expectations: at $337.22, Apple trades 17.6% above the displayed GF Value of $286.75. Local AI could give Macs a fresh selling point, but the economics depend on how heavily customers use the machines. A large upfront purchase saves money only if the cloud bills it replaces are large enough to cover the hardware and the work of managing it.

title: Apple Slips as $20,000 Macs Challenge Token Rent
